name: portfolio-building-plan
description:
Builds a plan for creating a freelance or professional portfolio including content
selection criteria, portfolio structure, case study format, and a 30-60-90 day
publishing schedule. Produces a complete portfolio development plan document.
Use when the user wants to build a professional portfolio, create a freelance
portfolio website, select work samples, or plan a portfolio launch for career
advancement or client acquisition.
Do NOT use for personal brand strategy (use personal-brand-strategy), resume writing
(use resume-bullet-writer), or website development (use web development skills).
